title: FTC Lawsuit Puts Amazon’s Advertising Pricing Under New Scrutiny
dek: The FTC and 22 states allege Amazon secretly charged businesses more for advertising, opening a new front in regulatory scrutiny of the company’s marketplace power.
socialCaption: The FTC and 22 states are suing Amazon over allegations of a “secret ad surcharge scheme.” The case puts marketplace advertising pricing—and the cost of visibility for sellers—under sharper scrutiny.
